newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Merrill Lynch buys 12.5 pct of Bezeq.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch buys 12.5 pct of Bezeq.

text.p: Israel has agreed to sell 90.6 million shares or 12.5 percent of Bezeq Israel Telecom to Merrill Lynch for $250 million, government officials told a news conference on Monday.
The deal is split into two packages, said Moshe Leon, senior economic adviser to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Tzippi Livni, head of the Government Corporations Authority.
The first package of 2.5 percent of Bezeq's shares is being sold for $50 million, or five percent below market value as of last Thursday. Merrill Lynch cannot return these shares to the government.

An additional 10 percent is being sold at market value for $200 million. Merrill Lynch has five months from September 1 to sell these shares to its clients. The government has agreed to buy back any unsold shares from this pacakge after the five-month period.
